## Which image models let you adapt the generator? {#sc-compare-image-control .fv-slide .sc-slide .sc-compare background-color="#ffffff"}

```{=html}
<div class="fv-meta"><span class="fv-id">S 52 / 95</span><span class="fv-cluster">LLM</span><span class="fv-cluster active">Text-to-image</span><span class="fv-cluster">Text-to-video</span><span class="fv-cluster">Text-to-speech</span><span class="fv-cluster">Music</span><a class="sc-back" href="#/sc-toc">All models ↗</a></div>
<div class="sc-body cmp-body cmp-rows-4">
<p class="cmp-intro">A local checkpoint, a hosted model and a cloud LoRA endpoint offer different kinds of control</p>
<table class="cmp-table" aria-label="Which image models let you adapt the generator?"><colgroup><col style="width:24%"><col style="width:25%"><col style="width:28%"><col style="width:23%"></colgroup><thead><tr><th scope="col">Model / variant</th><th scope="col">What can run locally?</th><th scope="col">Sampling / adaptation</th><th scope="col">Constraint to check</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><th scope="row"><a href="#sc-t2i-flux-2">FLUX.2 [dev]</a></th><td><span class="cmp-primary">32B generator</span><span class="cmp-detail">+ Mistral-3 24B encoder</span></td><td>Example: 50 steps, guidance 4.<br>Diffusers / ComfyUI.</td><td>[dev] Non-Commercial License; hosted models differ.</td></tr><tr><th scope="row"><a href="#sc-t2i-flux-2-klein">FLUX.2 [klein]</a></th><td><span class="cmp-primary">4B / 9B generators</span><span class="cmp-detail">Base + distilled checkpoints</span></td><td>Distilled: 4 steps.<br>Base + LoRA workflow.</td><td>4B: Apache-2.0.<br>9B: non-commercial licence.</td></tr><tr><th scope="row"><a href="#sc-t2i-flux3-klein">FLUX 3 Image Klein</a></th><td><span class="cmp-primary">5.6B generator</span><span class="cmp-detail">+ Qwen3-VL-4B encoder</span></td><td>Distilled: 16 steps, no CFG.<br>Base: 50 steps, CFG 3.5; LoRA.</td><td>FLUX Kommunity v1.0;<br>1K API output: $0.009.</td></tr><tr><th scope="row"><a href="#sc-t2i-wan-27-image">Wan2.7 Image</a></th><td><span class="cmp-primary">No public weights found</span><span class="cmp-detail">cloud adaptation workflow</span></td><td>Cloud SFT-LoRA + model ID.<br>Boxes and HEX palette control.</td><td>Pro T2I ≤4096²;<br>edits / Standard ≤2048².</td></tr></tbody></table>
<p class="cmp-caveat">Step count is not latency: model size, encoder, hardware and resolution differ. Open weights and commercial permission are separate questions.</p>

<div class="fv-takeaway">Local adaptation points to a Base checkpoint; Wan offers adaptation through a cloud service.</div>
```

::: {.notes}
Здесь сравнение отвечает на вопрос лабораторной работы: где студент сможет менять параметры генератора и обучать адаптер. FLUX.2 dev, klein и FLUX 3 Klein дают локальные варианты с разными лицензиями и sampling. У Wan есть cloud SFT-LoRA, но это не локальные веса. Четыре и шестнадцать шагов не являются готовым сравнением скорости: различаются backbone, энкодер, разрешение и железо. Нельзя переносить размеры dev на hosted FLUX.2. Размер генератора не включает автоматически все дополнительные компоненты.

**Evidence scope.** Comparison of the deck's supplied audit and results snapshots. No fresh model execution or current-price verification. Arithmetic and task implications are editorial derivations, not additional benchmark measurements.
